statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes used are I25.10 and I34.0
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The service was appropriately ordered to detect clinically significant arrhythmias responsible for the patient's symptoms
